x: Ready for anything the Team Manager can throw at them! Thamesiders Lizzy Hodges, Lucy Hopkins, Charlotte Hopkins and Jenny Hodges at Tooting in July 1999.
Lizzy Hodges was 64th in the Girls' 11/12 event in 19:51 but Louise Collier got kicked in the scramble at the start and was unable to finish.

Unlike the race at Tilford, however, this time Louise had team mates highly placed to back her up and with Jessie Massey in second place and Lizzy Hodges in fourth, the team scored a great win over Guildford & Godalming.

What a shame that young Lizzy Hodges was unable to run through illness. In every race this summer past Lizzy has been just those few seconds behind Louise and the pair of them could form the basis of a really powerful team in the next few years.
